import re

_HEADING = re.compile(r"(#{1,6}) +(.*)")
_FENCE = re.compile(r"(```|~~~)")
# Requires whitespace before the closing hashes so that "C#" keeps its "#".
_CLOSING = re.compile(r"(?:^|\s)#+$")


def _headings(markdown: str):
    """Yield (level, title) for each ATX heading outside fenced code blocks."""
    fence = None
    for line in markdown.splitlines():
        # A fence only closes with the same marker that opened it, so
        # a ``` line inside a ~~~ block is ordinary content.
        if fence:
            if line.startswith(fence):
                fence = None
            continue
        fence_match = _FENCE.match(line)
        if fence_match:
            fence = fence_match.group(1)
            continue
        match = _HEADING.match(line)
        if match:
            title = _CLOSING.sub("", match.group(2).strip()).strip()
            yield len(match.group(1)), title


def _anchor(title: str, used: set[str]) -> str:
    """Return a GitHub-style anchor for title that is unique within used."""
    base = "".join(c for c in title.lower() if c.isalnum() or c in " -_")
    base = base.replace(" ", "-")
    anchor = base
    n = 0
    # GitHub numbers duplicates from -1 upward, skipping any suffix already taken.
    while anchor in used:
        n += 1
        anchor = f"{base}-{n}"
    used.add(anchor)
    return anchor


def toc(markdown: str, max_level: int = 3) -> str:
    """Return a Markdown table of contents for headings up to max_level.

    Indentation is two spaces per level below the shallowest included
    heading. Returns an empty string when there are no matching headings.
    """
    entries = [(level, title) for level, title in _headings(markdown) if level <= max_level]
    if not entries:
        return ""
    top = min(level for level, _ in entries)
    used: set[str] = set()
    lines = []
    for level, title in entries:
        indent = "  " * (level - top)
        lines.append(f"{indent}- [{title}]

(#a-1)\n"
        "- [A](#a-2)\n"
    )


def test_heading_text_is_stripped_of_surrounding_whitespace():
    assert toc("#    Padded   \n") == "- [Padded](#padded)\n"
EOF
